qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: Three distinct crafted softly rounded salvage variants with readable blue-gray metal/wood, controlled broad highlights, stable attachments and coherent grounded loops/upward collect shrink.

priorityOutcomes.success: Three recognizable salvage variants share a crafted, chunky, softly rounded metal vocabulary: a plate fragment, a bent fragment, and a mixed metal/wood assembly. Main masses and junctions read intentionally constructed rather than generic boxes or accidental overlaps. Plate target motivates a more substantial framed top and legible fasteners; exact old counts or target fastener count are not locked. Preserve meaningful variant differences rather than cloning the target plate into all clips.

Retain cool blue-gray metal and deep navy/slate recesses; retain the mixed variant wood role. Soft light values separate upper planes, edges and lower mass without bleaching the top into a single near-white blank. Restrained warm wear can add salvage character while leaving clean broad fields; target rust distribution, scratches, and plant green/orange palette are not mandatory.

Broad, soft native highlights and rounded edge light reveal volume coherently in N/E/S/W. Lower metal stays readable against gray and dark backgrounds. Honor symmetric horizontal illumination and no directional ground shadows; the ImageGen bright left glow is not a requirement to create a preferred light direction.

Purposeful bevels, seams, fasteners, small dents or restrained wear improve tactile construction at logical192x352 and phone0.45 scale. Metallic identity can be matte or softly sheened; avoid mirror-like hotspots, speckled corrosion, dense microtexture and imagegen fringe.

Every required phase/facing retains a readable silhouette with stable native attachments within the fragment, clean plane separation, no unexplained black patches, floating decoration, coplanar artifacts, clipping, halos or alpha contamination. Late collect is deliberately tiny and held; do not demand full rest-size legibility from the terminal remnant.

All variants preserve their required shimmer/attract loop role and collect lift/shrink one-shot role, correct twelve-phase 12fps cadence, seamless duplicate native closure outside published unique phases, and terminal hold. Native motion improvements are welcome when coherent and within the root-reconciled envelope. Do not invent attraction travel to the submarine; current source defines no collector socket or contact.
